reading.title: Roads or railways?
reading.text: Every government says it wants to improve infrastructure, but the real question is what to construct. In my view, building more motorways is a mistake. New roads attract more traffic, and within a few years they are as crowded as before. Their construction also causes the destruction of farmland and forests. Some economists argue that roads are essential for rural businesses, and I accept that remote villages need good access. However, for travel between cities, high-speed railways offer a far better structure for long-term growth.
